'''Meteor''' was the callsign of a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] who led [[Havoc Squad]], the premier unit in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Receiving top marks in the academy, the soldier was assigned to Havoc Squad as a [[sergeant]] while the unit was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]]. However, Havoc's mission to recover a stolen [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] left the sergeant as the only remaining member of the unit when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harron Tavus]] led the rest of the squad and many other SpecForce personnel in defecting to the Empire, sparking the [[SpecForce Incident]].

Promoted to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], "Meteor" was given command of Havoc, and tasked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] with hunting down the traitors alongside the recently demoted [[Aric Jorgan]]. Havoc pursued its former members to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], gaining new members in Sergeant [[Elara Dorne]] and the experimental [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[M1-4X]]. The SpecForce Incident came to a head when Havoc assaulted Tavus's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Justice (Harrower-class)|''Justice'']], and captured the traitor.

As [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] headed towards renewed war, Havoc Squad was tasked with destroying the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] built by the Empire. At Garza's behest, Havoc rebuilt its ranks, recruiting [[Tanno Vik]] on war-torn [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] as a demolitions expert, and the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman]] [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] from his assignment of rebuilding an Imperial [[black cipher]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. With the squad fully rebuilt, Havoc launched a [[Battle of the Gauntlet|coordinated assault]] on the Gauntlet that saw the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] destroyed&mdash;but doing so earned Havoc the wrath of General [[Arkos Rakton]], the Empire's most brilliant and most ruthless commander.

In order to combat Rakton's campaign of revenge against the Republic amid the ongoing war, Havoc was deployed across the galaxy, rescuing kidnapped Republic leaders from a [[Outpost 256|trap]] set by Rakton and recruiting the unfairly disgraced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Dagger Wing]] from the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] amid an [[Invasion of Belsavis|Imperial invasion]]. After rescuing Republic prisoners-of-war from Rakton's clutches despite another [[A-77 operation|trap]], Havoc freed up Republic resources on the planet [[Voss]] before joining the ongoing [[Battle of Corellia]], pushing through to Rakton's command center in the occupied [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]]. Meteor and the rest of Havoc successfully breached the Bastion and captured Rakton, earning the [[Cross of Glory]] and a promotion to [[Major/Legends|major]] for the commander and the [[Gold Crescent]] for the rest of the unit.

Havoc Squad continued to serve under their commander's leadership in the coming [[Standard year/Legends|years]], playing parts in campaigns such as the one to foil the [[Order of Revan]]'s designs on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. However, the major vanished in [[3636 BBY]], shortly before the Republic and the Empire were [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded and conquered]] by the [[Eternal Empire]] from [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The squad continued to serve valiantly in their leader's absence, but soon fractured, leaving Aric Jorgan in command of a new Havoc. Though Havoc's former members searched the galaxy for their commander, the major was eventually declared [[Death/Legends|dead]] and posthumously promoted to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|People, this is the new sergeant I mentioned&mdash;ranked first in the Academy in Forward Assault, Search and Destroy, and Advanced Recon. It's good to have you, Sergeant.|Harron Tavus|<ref name="Hit the Ground Running">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hit the Ground Running|Ord Mantell}}</ref>}}
The future Havoc commander was ranked first in the Academy of Forward Assault, Search and Destroy, and Advanced Recon, becoming a talented soldier and combat leader during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. The soon-to-be Commander served early tours in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and, while still a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], was transferred to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during its [[Separatist War|civil war]] to join the Republic's most decorated [[Republic Special Forces Division|special forces]] combat unit, [[Havoc Squad]].{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
===Ord Mantell civil war===
{{Quote|Another beautiful day on Ord Mantell.|Lieutenant Bex Kolos, nicknamed "Gearbox"|<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />}}
====New squad member====
{{Quote|I'll fight the enemies of the Republic with everything I've got, sir.|The Lieutenant to Kolos|<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />}}
[[File:Havoc_OM.png|thumb|150px|The Sergeant's squadmates]]
Upon arrival in orbit around the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the [[Republic transport shuttle|starship]] carrying the Sergeant evaded an ongoing space battle between the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist fleet]] and the Republic Navy. Safely entering the atmosphere of Ord Mantell, the future [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and a group of [[Republic trooper]]s set foot on Mantellian ground. The Sergeant was welcomed with a snappy salute by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bex Kolos]], also known as Gearbox, a member of Havoc Squad just as he disembarked. The trooper was then ordered to enter a [[Manka-class armored transport]] that was about to depart to a Republic outpost called [[Fort Garnik]], where he was supposed to meet up with the rest of his new unit. Inside the APC, Kolos introduced himself and briefed the Sergeant about their [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Havoc Squad)|objective]] on the planet. A powerful [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]], called the [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb|ZR-57]], was stolen by Mantellian separatists after shooting down a Republic ship that was carrying it. The weapon being capable of massive destruction, the mission to recover it was given to the elite unit Havoc Squad.<ref name="Prologue">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Prologue|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

While the walker was moving near the [[Drelliad village]], the separatist launched an assault on the location. The APC, carrying the Sergeant, Gearbox and others, was shot down by two [[armor-piercing missile]]s. Suffering several casualties including the [[Unidentified Republic APC driver|driver]], Gearbox assigned the Sergeant to disable the missile launchers in the village while he reorganized the Republic troopers who survived the crash, preparing them to move out and try to fix the [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. The Sergeant complied and reached the village. There he met with Sergeant [[Jendan Blyes|Blyes]] and his men, who were under fire during the [[Battle in Drelliad village|ongoing battle]]. Blyes asked the Sergeant to take out the Separatist [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]] which were blocking their communications, a task the Sergeant accepted and succeeded in.<ref name="Clearing the Air">{{TORcite|type=general|Clearing the Air|Ord Mantell}}</ref> The Sergeant then eliminated several more separatists and destroyed the [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. Afterwards, Gearbox contacted the Sergeant, congratulating the subordinate for the mission's success and telling the Sergeant to reach Fort Garnik on foot while he would scavenge the walker, having failed to repair it.<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" /><ref name="Take Back Drelliad Village">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Take Back Drelliad Village|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

[[File:Fort_Garnik.jpg|thumb|250px|Fort Garnik on Ord Mantell]]
Upon arrival to the Republic base, the Sergeant was welcomed by Sergeant [[Jaynes]].<ref name="Best of the Best">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Best of the Best|Ord Mantell}}</ref> Afterwards, the Sergeant entered the barracks, where he was approached by a private named [[Farn]], who introduced himself telling the sergeant that it was an honor to meet a member of the legendary Havoc Squad. The Sergeant then finally regrouped with Havoc Squad, which received the new blood fairly well. The squad's leader, the famous Commander [[Harron Tavus]], then introduced the veteran squad members: the second-in-command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zora]]; the explosives expert, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Vanto Bazren]]; and the combat medic, Lieutenant [[Ryler Dorant]].<ref name="The Spy">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Spy|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

Commander Tavus started briefing Havoc Squad on their overarching mission on the planet, to recover the stolen [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] in the region of [[Avilatan]]. Considering that the weapon could vaporize an entire island, the Republic had initially sent a recovery team, but by the time they arrived, the bomb had already been stolen by the Separatists. Tavus then assigned the Sergeant to obtain information about the possible bomb's location from the Republic [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Bellis]], who was waiting to report in the town of [[Talloran village|Talloran]].<ref name="The Spy" />

Before the Sergeant could go on with the mission, Tavus lastly introduced Lieutenant [[Aric Jorgan]], from the Republic's [[Ord Mantell Infantry Command]], who would oversee the Sergeant's progress in the mission and provide intel when necessary. Jorgan also made it clear that he was in charge and his orders were to be followed without question. When the Sergeant [[Mission to Talloran village (Havoc Squad)|reached]] the "hot" meeting spot in Talloran, the Sergeant found Bellis dead. Immediately contacting Jorgan and reporting the death, the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] tasked the Sergeant with finding and acquire Bellis' field box, which would contain the info that the spy was trying to reveal before his death.<ref name="The Spy" /><ref name="Clean Up Talloran">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Clean Up Talloran|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

[[File:Bellis-TOR.png|thumb|left|150px|Bellis' corpse in Talloran village]]
The Sergeant entered [[Bellis's house]] in Talloran to recover his field box. Upon entering, the trooper was approached by Bellis' wife, [[Lin]], who at first tried to disguise her husband's profession, considering she didn't even know that he had been killed. The Sergeant revealed his death and Lin, outraged by the fact that he died while in the service, told the Sergeant to leave the house without hearing the Sergeant's request. The trooper reiterated the value of serving the Republic and the nobility of her husband's death, which further outraged Lin, but in the end she acquiesced and gave Bellis' field box to the Sergeant.<ref name="The Spy" />

The Sergeant returned to Fort Garnik and gave Bellis' field box to Jorgan, who then told the Sergeant to talk to Bazren while he decoded the information that was recovered. Bazren assigned the Sergeant with a new task, telling the Sergeant that a mysterious informant called [[Mirru]] had come to the Republic base and informed the officers that he knew of a planned separatist bombing happening on that very day. The Republic forces, however, initially refused to believe him due to the influx of refugees offering questionable intel for any form of remuneration. The soldiers kicked Mirru out of the fort after beating him up to discourage further actions. Bazren decided that any and all information was worth investigation and so sent the Sergeant to talk to Mirru to verify his claims. The Sergeant sought the informant in the Fort Garnik refugee camp, just outside Fort Garnik. Upon meeting and speaking to him, the informant was skeptical at first but then the Sergeant convinced him to reveal the Separatists' plan to use several bombs in an ambush along the road. Jorgan, who overheard the conversation through the [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], immediately assigned the Sergeant to disarm the bombs, as a Republic convoy was preparing to move along that road in the [[Avilatan Badlands]].<ref name="The Ambush">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Ambush|Ord Mantell}}</ref><ref name="Counter-Insurgency">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Counter-Insurgency|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

After concluding his [[Mission in the Avilatan Badlands|mission]] and returning to the Barracks, the Sergeant was intercepted by private Farn once again, who told his superior that most soldiers in the base were corrupt, and he could only trust the promising Sergeant, revealing that his CO, Lieutenant [[Virk]], was scamming everyone under his command. The Sergeant agreed to help him, saying that as a Havoc Squad member, the Sergeant could report the corrupt official to higher authorities, alerting them to Virk's ongoing scam. The Sergeant then met with Tavus, who congratulated the promising trooper for successfully ending the ambush and saving the Republic convoy. Lieutenant Jorgan then approached the Sergeant and said that he had deciphered Bellis' field box which revealed the bomb's location. The Separatists were keeping the bomb in their outpost on the island of [[Mannett Point]]. While discussing the security features of the outpost, the sergeant suggested the possibility that the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] had a hand in the civil war due to presence of advanced weaponry and Mannett Point's unassailable nature. Dismissing the idea for later thought, Tavus told the Sergeant to rendezvous with Zora and [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|retrieve]] the ZR-57. Before leaving, the Sergeant informed Tavus and Jorgan about Virk's corruption, and they agreed to investigate it further.<ref name="Mannett Point">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Mannett Point|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

===Progress on Ord Mantell===
{{Quote|Saphrro, Vyru and Bol are priority-one targets, Sergeant.|Aric Jorgan|<ref name="Mannett Point" />}}
[[File:Havoc_traitors.png|thumb|left|200px|Tavus, Fuse, Gearbox, and Needles confront the sergeant.]]
Upon arriving at the [[Separatist Base|Separatist outpost]] on Mannett Point, subduing several separatists along the way, the Sergeant met with Zora. She assigned the trooper to destroy the Outpost's generator while she would take care of the [[Force field/Legends|force field]] that prevented them from acquiring the bomb. After destroying the generator, the Sergeant encountered several wounded Separatists, including [[Jex (Separatist)|Jex]] and [[Grannin]], who begged for mercy. The Sergeant decided to let them go with the condition that they would not fight anymore. Afterwards, the Sergeant regrouped with Wraith&mdash;Zora's code name&mdash;who had, by then, disabled the force field. Both entered the room where the stolen bomb was supposedly being kept, where they encountered an unprepared separatist officer, [[Dalern]], who still refused to surrender to the Republic's will. Speaking to the isolated officer, the Sergeant convinced him to cooperate shortly after. Both Republic soldiers then discovered that the bomb had been moved to a different place, so Wraith executed Dalern and assigned the Sergeant to find more useful Separatist officers who could reveal the bomb's location.<ref name="Mannett Point" /><ref name="Bringing the Battle to Them">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Bringing the Battle to Them|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

While searching the base for more officers, the Sergeant eventually encountered a room where three high-ranking Separatists were meeting. One of those officers, [[Saphrro]], ordered another, [[Vyru]], to attack the Republic trooper. However, Vyru was killed, followed by his two partners, Saphrro and a third officer, [[Bol (Separatist)|Bol]].<ref name="Mannett Point" />

The Sergeant, failing to locate the bomb, retreated to Fort Garnik, informing Needles&mdash;Ryler Dorant's code name&mdash;about the mission's result. Even though the Sergeant failed to retrieve the bomb or its location, Needles told the Sergeant that the mission had been a success because four separatist officers had been killed, crippling the Separatists' presence in the area.<ref name="Mannett Point" />

Needles then told the Sergeant about a man named [[Zak (Separatist)|Zak]] from [[Oradam village]], who had been in the Republic's outpost, requesting medical supplies due to his radiation illness. The Republic officers determined that he had been poisoned by the radiation emitted by the bomb. With this discovery, the Sergeant was ordered to retrieve information from the crippled Zak, who could reveal where the bomb was being kept. The Sergeant complied and met with Zak and his wife, [[Jaller]], questioning them about the bomb's location in exchange for the cure for the radiation poisoning. The couple revealed themselves to be separatists but agreed nonetheless to give the location.<ref name="Oradam Village">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Oradam Village|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

Now finally with the bomb's location, the Sergeant was called to regroup with the rest of Havoc Squad in Fort Garnik's barracks. While entering the barracks, the Sergeant was intercepted by the corrupt Virk, who threatened the sergeant due to the scrutiny of an official investigation into his corrupt practices that the trooper had requested. Ending the conversation, the Sergeant proceeded to Havoc's rendezvous spot but was met by Jorgan, who revealed that Commander Tavus had taken Havoc Squad to recover the bomb but decided to keep the Sergeant out of it. Jorgan was then informed by a [[Unidentified technician (Ord Mantell)|technician]] that they had lost all communications with Havoc Squad. Jorgan, shocked by this event, decided to send the Sergeant to follow his squad and aid in locating the ZR-57, disregarding Tavus' command.<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Separatists' Stronghold|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

[[File:Jorgan-combat.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Aric Jorgan was demoted to sergeant and placed under the lieutenant's command.]]
The Sergeant was able to locate the bomb in another Separatist Base and finally disabled it, finding that Havoc Squad was still nowhere to be found. The Republic trooper had, however, made another troubling discovery, noticing that some of the opposing forces protecting the base were actually [[Imperial soldier]]s, revealing the Sith Empire's affiliation with the Separatists.<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" />

The Sergeant reached a hangar within the facility, finding that the rest of Havoc Squad was very much alive. Wraith attempted to kill the Sergeant but was stopped by Tavus, who then revealed to the Sergeant that Havoc was going to [[SpecForce Incident|desert]] the Republic for the Sith Empire, as the latter seemed to value soldiers more than the former. The Sergeant attempted to redeem Havoc Squad, but to no avail. Tavus continued to explain that Havoc felt betrayed after the Senate abandoned them during the [[mission to Ando Prime]]. Tavus then ordered the Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Vorr (Imperial)|Vorr]] and his Imperials to attack the Sergeant, who defeated the opponents regardless. However, the Sergeant's fight to survive the attack had been enough for the treacherous Havoc Squad to escape in a [[Imperial assault shuttle|shuttle]], taking the supposedly neutralized bomb with them to present it as a gift to the Empire.<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" />

===Promotion===
{{Quote|In recognition of your valiant service, I hereby promote you to the rank of lieutenant. Congratulations.|General Vander|<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" />}}
[[File:JekKardan.png|thumb|right|150px|Jek Kardan, the lieutenant's Coruscant target]]
Upon returning to Fort Garnik, the Sergeant learned that Republic Command was well aware of Tavus' betrayal after witnessing the events through the Sergeant's armor camera. Due to the honorable yet unsuccessful efforts of the Sergeant, command promoted the trooper to the rank of lieutenant and gave them command of the recently deserted squad while Lieutenant Jorgan was demoted to sergeant and placed under the command of the trooper due to his superiors' need of a scapegoat.<ref name="|New Assignment">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|New Assignment|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

After a quick stopover on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]] for specialization training,<ref name="Advanced Training: Trooper">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Advanced Training: Trooper|Carrick Station}}</ref> the CO of Havoc Squad journeyed to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to report to the head of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]].<ref name="The Coruscant Assignment">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Coruscant Assignment|Carrick Station}}</ref> Upon arriving, Garza briefed the erstwhile sergeant that Tavus had led hundreds of special forces troopers to defect to the Empire, and that the only advantage the Republic had at the moment was Havoc Squad, as Tavus presumed the CO dead. Though Jorgan was all for going out to hunt down Tavus and his followers, Garza stressed that they first had to take out the traitors' underworld contacts on Coruscant.<ref name="Destroying the War Droids">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Destroying the War Droids|Coruscant}}</ref>

Garza first sent the Lieutenant and Jorgan to the [[Old Galactic Market]], putting them in contact with one of her men, [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Garrum]]. The corporal told them that their first target was a cyborg named [[Krel]]. The cyborg had been capturing civilians and apparently implanting them with their illegal cybernetics. Fighting through Krel's army of war droids, the Lieutenant and Jorgan found Krel in his facility. Though the trooper offered Krel a chance to surrender, the cyborg refused, and attacked the Lieutenant. Forced to kill Krel, the Lieutenant was then ordered by Garza to kill all the enhanced civilians within the facility. Jorgan noted that it didn't feel right, and that they didn't know whether the civilians really were enhanced or not. Ultimately, the Lieutenant agreed with Jorgan and let the civilians go after being given their names and identification numbers. Garza criticized the Lieutenant for this, saying that they needed to follow her orders over their brain, and then their brain over their heart.<ref name="Destroying the War Droids" /> However, a report filed to Garza by Corporal [[Garrum]] later confirmed that the civilians hadn't been implanted.<ref name="MMG report">{{TORcite|After-Action Report: Migrant Merchants Guild from Corporal Garrum to General Garza}}</ref>

Next, Havoc was sent to [[Black Sun territory]] to meet with Sergeant [[Ava Jaxo]]. Jaxo and the Lieutenant worked together and tracked a batch of nerve toxin canisters that [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] was shipping to Tavus and the other traitors. Jaxo also asked the Lieutenant to bring her a mysterious red case that Black Sun had retrieved. The Lieutenant and Jorgan succeeded, neutralizing the gas and retrieving the case, which had a strange prototype blaster inside.<ref name="The Black Sun's Poison">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Black Sun's Poison|Coruscant}}</ref>

After succeeding in Black Sun territory, the Lieutenant was summoned to a [[Senate]] hearing regarding Havoc's defection. The CO answered as many of the committee's questions as he could, but when asked if the events on Ando Prime were the cause of Havoc's defection, a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Senator told the CO to disregard it. General Garza was pleased with how the Lieutenant handled the hearing, and briefed Havoc on their next mission. Before leaving, the CO asked about the truth about Ando Prime. Garza confessed that when they sent Havoc to cut off an Imperial offensive then discovered that enemy forces were far greater than intel had led them to believe. Just as they were about to extract Havoc, the Senate cut them off, claiming that the operation was unauthorized and threatened to breach the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Under Kardan's leadership at the time, Havoc found their own way home. Kardan resigned upon learning the truth, and Tavus took over the squad, neither man being the same since. As the CO lamented that Tavus was telling the truth, Garza reminded Havoc that regardless of the difficult situation the old Havoc had to face, it didn't excuse their actions.<ref name="The Senate Inquiry">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Senate Inquiry|Coruscant}}</ref>

Continuing with the mission, the Lieutenant and Jorgan were sent to [[Justicars' Brigade|Justicar]] territory to find and capture [[Jek Kardan]] alive. Finding the former commander of Havoc Squad in negotiations with an Imperial, the squad was initially assumed by Kardan to be mere grunts. But upon recognizing the symbol of Havoc Squad on the teams' armor, Kardan tried to escape by pitting the present Imperial forces against the new squad.<ref name="More Old Friends">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|More Old Friends|Coruscant}}</ref> After defeating the Imperial incursion in the facility, Havoc Squad eventually tracked Kardan down in [[The Works/Legends|The Works]],<ref name="Assault on the Works">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Assault on the Works|Coruscant}}</ref> where he was guarding a transmitter responsible for the defectors' communications. Havoc destroyed the transmitter, and after a lengthy conversation about the situation, the lieutenant convinced Kardan to help bring in his comrades.<ref name="Clearing Airwave">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Clearing Airwaves|Coruscant}}</ref>

===The hunt begins===
====Rescuing a Senator====
With the threats on Coruscant quelled, the Lieutenant and his companion returned to Garza's office where upon speaking to the general the duo was finally given the task of capturing or killing the traitors of Havoc Squad and the many other Special Forces defectors. Given the galactic nature of their mission, Garza requisitioned a [[BT-7 Thunderclap]] to serve as the squad's transportation.<ref name="Public Relations">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Public Relations|Port Raga}}</ref>

She told them that Wraith had captured Senator [[Zorin Krasul]], a member of the committee that questioned the CO, and was holding him hostage. Traveling to the space station [[Port Raga]], Havoc rendezvoused with the Republic team already there, led by Sergeant Jaxo. Jaxo briefed the Lieutenant on the situation, disclosing that the arrival of Havoc Squad was inconspicuous, the neutral space station was taken over by opposing forces, and the Senator was being held in a hangar filled with explosives at the other end of the station. The squad moved out to find the senator and engaged the treacherous ex-Republic forces and Imperial commandos that sought to stop them.<ref name="The Price of Betrayal">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|The Price of Betrayal|Port Raga}}</ref> After eliminating the opposing forces, the duo found the captive Senator sitting on a bomb chair set with an inflated dead-man's switch. As the trooper approached the senator, the boisterous Cathar rudely ordered the lieutenant to free him.<ref name="Public Relations" />

While examining the situation, the trooper asked the senator about the motivations of Wraith behind his kidnapping. The senator quickly revealed that renegade troop wanted him to publicly acknowledge the events on Ando Prime, which would have destabilized the Galactic Senate's inner workings. Asking further about the truth behind the ill-fated mission, the senator further revealed that the mission was conducted illegally, with the previous Havoc Squad invading the planet and engaging Imperial forces without the consent of the Senate.<ref name="Public Relations" />

After concluding the conversation, the trooper discovered that the bomb had three triggers: a weight switch, a remote trigger and an additional gas switch. The lieutenant moved to seal the bulkhead doors then vented the atmosphere in the hangar, modifying the atmospheric pressure in the area and thus disabling the gas trigger. After the procedure, the trooper raced to the senator's chair and defused the last two triggers with ease. With the senator freed, Havoc Squad escorted the senator to the hangar where Sergeant Jaxo and her team were waiting.<ref name="Public Relations" />

Before leaving, Jaxo had a short conversation with the commanding officer about how Wraith managed to slip past them even when they had eyes on the whole station, giving credence to the ex-Havoc member's skill in infiltration. Given the recent successes of the trooper, Jaxo invited the trooper to her place on Coruscant to celebrate.<ref name="A Little R and R">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|A Little R and R|Coruscant}}</ref> Upon reaching Havoc's starship, the trooper immediately reported to General Garza. Content with the trooper's report, Garza told the lieutenant that technicians collected new possible locations from the relay recovered during Havoc's previous mission on Coruscant. From the records, Garza surmised that the renegade troopers were operating on Taris and Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Public Relations" />

====Taris====
[[File:Elara.png|thumb|left|200px|Elara Dorne, Havoc's third member]]
Garza then sent Havoc to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the first of the defectors' location. She had contacted the local regiment commander, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gaff (colonel)|Gaff]], to assist them in any way possible, but he was not to know the details of their mission. Upon meeting with the colonel, he blatantly disregarded Garza's orders, partly due to the fact that their mission was top secret, claiming that nothing unusual happened under his watch. Suddenly, a female Human, Sergeant [[Elara Dorne]], spoke up, stating that patrol teams had gone missing. When Gaff attempted to shoot her down for speaking out of turn, she cited regulations that made Garza's orders a priority. Gaff dismissed her claims, insisting that they may have fallen prey to wildlife. As the colonel excused himself, Dorne apologized for Gaff's behavior, stating that it wasn't the first time he'd defied direct orders.<ref name="Welcome Party">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Welcome Party|Taris}}</ref>

With Dorne's aid, the Lieutenant and Jorgan searched for several missing squads of Republic scouts and traced them to an Imperial outpost.<ref name="Lost and Found">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Lost and Found|Taris}}</ref> There, Havoc's commander made a deal with an Imperial commander, [[Thorus]], who agreed to tell him where Needles was, if he was allowed to go free. Dorne then came in on holo, warning the CO not to broker any deals with him, explaining that she personally served under Thorus, who had committed war crimes in direct defiance of Imperial High Command. Thorus countered that he was only doing what was necessary to perform his duties and claimed that the CO was no different. Angered that he would compare himself to them, the CO raised a blaster, declaring they were nothing alike. Scared, Thorus confessed Needles' location and explained that he was experimenting with [[rakghoul]]s and other defectors. Though Sergeant Dorne recommended executing Thorus immediately, Havoc honored their agreement, letting the commander go.<ref name="Fallenspire Stronghold">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Fallenspire Stronghold|Taris}}</ref><ref name="An Imperial Presence">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|An Imperial Presence|Taris}}</ref><ref name="Not Welcome">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Not Welcome|Taris}}</ref>

They followed Needles to his base, where he was mutating Imperial soldiers into rakghouls. They killed Needles and his rakghouls, though the Lieutenant decided to destroy Needles' research rather than follow Jorgan's suggestion to bring it to General Garza. This displeased Garza, though she commended them for killing Needles. She hadn't told Kardan yet, but she doubted he'd be upset, as he and Needles never saw eye-to-eye.<ref name="The Arrangement">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Arrangement|Taris}}</ref><ref name="Liquidate the Laboratory">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Liquidate the Laboratory|Taris}}</ref> She also ordered Elara Dorne to join Havoc Squad, a transfer Dorne gladly accepted.<ref name="A New Ally">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|A New Ally|Taris}}</ref>

====Nar Shaddaa====
[[File:M1-4X.png|thumb|right|[[M1-4X]] became the fourth member of Havoc Squad.]]
Havoc soon landed on the Hutt moon of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Garza warned that the moon was neutral territory and advised against causing an incident. She then explained that Tavus' followers had reactivated a prototype Republic war droid designated [[M1-4X]], originally meant to serve in Havoc, and it was causing havoc on Nar Shaddaa. She had enlisted the aid of a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] (SIS) cell but ordered Havoc to avoid disclosure about their mission.<ref name="A New Player">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|A New Player|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

Disembarking from the ship, Havoc met with their SIS contact, [[Jonas Balkar]], in a cantina. In chasing Forex and his defector controllers, led by Captain [[Andrik]] the CO confessed the true details of their mission to Balkar rather than keep him in the dark. During the course of their chase, they infiltrated an Imperial outpost in a casino. As the Imperials raised their weapons, Andrik came on holo. He refused to aid the Imperials, knowing they'd be dead. Rather than start a firefight and cause an incident, the CO convinced the Imperials that Andrik didn't care about the Empire, and they gave up his location in Shadow Town, where he was attempting to fully activate Forex's experimental power core. Upon confronting the defectors, Andrik dismissed the CO as an obedient grunt. He claimed that the Republic would eventually abandon them too, but the CO would have none of it. At that moment, Forex was fully activated. Though unable to disobey Andrik, the droid expressed hope that Havoc Squad would prevail. In a quick firefight, they killed Andrik and his followers and destroyed Forex. Later returning to an SIS safehouse, Havoc walked in on an argument between Balkar and Garza over Havoc's mission. Garza was displeased that the CO disobeyed orders. As the general signed off, Balkar revealed that they had repaired Forex to serve in Havoc Squad.<ref name="The Republic's Finest">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Republic's Finest|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Reaching Out">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Reaching Out|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Cause Some Havoc">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Cause Some Havoc|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Climbing the Ladder">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Climbing the Ladder|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Crashing the Club">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Crashing the Club|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Overloaded">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Overloaded|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref><ref name="Charging the Charging Facility">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Charging the Charging Facility|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

====Into the trap====
Garza next assigned Havoc Squad to attack Tavus' ship, which had been tracked after Tavus and a squad of Imperial commandos had stolen prototype cloaking devices. Traveling to Tavus' ship, Havoc Squad fought through the automated defenses. However, they had been tricked&mdash;Tavus was not, in fact, aboard the ship. Tavus contacted the Lieutenant via holocomm, telling them that he had intentionally arranged for the Lieutenant to be there, and ridiculed them for killing Needles and Captain Andrik. Tavus revealed an Imperial unit called the [[Shadow Fist]], which had been a constant rival of Havoc Squad's during the [[Great Galactic War|first war]], was aboard the ship. The Lieutenant fought and defeated all members of the Shadow Fist and recovered the stealth generator.<ref name="The Shadow Fist">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Shadow Fist|Tavus's Ship}}</ref><ref name="Racing to Destruction">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Racing to Destruction|Tavus's Ship}}</ref><ref name="Stay Frosty">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Stay Frosty|Tavus's Ship}}</ref>

===Phase two===
====Tatooine====
[[File:Fuse.png|thumb|left|150px|Fuse, the Havoc traitor who was captured on Tatooine]]
With the recovery of the stealth generator, Havoc Squad was sent to the desert world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, they found the mayor of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], [[Oleg Klerren]], who informed the Lieutenant that the Imperials had been placing bombs into protocol droids and sending them into Anchorhead, killing many innocent beings. They received a report of a bomb that had just been set off, and Havoc went to the site quickly. They found an injured man who informed them that the protocol droids had entered the buildings and exploded, and they were forced to battle a new wave of the sabotaged droids.<ref name="Rapid Response">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Rapid Response|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="Patch-up the Wounded">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Patch-up the Wounded|Tatooine}}</ref>

Returning to the mayor Klerren, Havoc informed them of the successful mission. Then they were contacted by [[Vanto Bazren|Fuse]], one of the Havoc defectors. Fuse told them that the bombs were being engineered by [[Geonosian]]s in the desert. Havoc went to the Geonosian compound and found the Geonosians in contact with an Imperial named [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]]. Gorik ordered the Geonosian leader, [[Kyvax]], to kill Havoc. Havoc succeeded in eliminating all of the Geonosian forces and returned to mayor Klerren. Fuse told the mayor he regretted his decision, because innocent people were being hurt with his designs. Klerren reassured Fuse that he was doing the right thing.<ref name="Interception">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Interception|Tatooine}}</ref>

Fuse then told Havoc of an Imperial commando team near [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] territory, using Fuse's designs of mines and bombs on the Sand People. The Lieutenant and their squad set out to deal with them. Inside the [[Hidden cave (Jundland Wastes)|cave]] the Imperials were hiding in, a technician expressed doubt, saying he thought Havoc had defected to the Empire. The commando sergeant replied that they'd sort it out when the Republic forces were dead, and his squad opened fire. The Lieutenant made quick work of the Imperials and killed them all save for the technician, who surrendered. Havoc allowed the technician to go free on the stipulation that he reveal the location of the Imperial base. That known, they set out to stop Gorik.<ref name="Sandstorm">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Sandstorm|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="Imperial Shut Down">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Imperial Shut Down|Tatooine}}</ref>

At the Imperial base, the squad found Fuse in a cell. Fuse said that Gorik was getting away, and that Havoc should stop him. At that moment, the self-destruct was activated, and Havoc was forced to choose&mdash;free Fuse or go after Gorik. The Lieutenant chose to follow the primary mission of returning the Havoc traitors, and freed Fuse, turning him over to the Republic forces; however, Gorik was allowed to escape. This disappointed Garza, but she was pleased that Havoc finally brought in one of the traitors alive, as Kardan was beginning to doubt her promise.<ref name="Evacuation">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Evacuation|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="Base Offensive">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Base Offensive|Tatooine}}</ref>

====Alderaan====
[[File:Bex_Kolos.png|thumb|right|150px|The Lieutenant was forced to kill Gearbox on Alderaan.]]
With their success on Tatooine, Havoc Squad was sent to the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to track down Gearbox. Liaising with [[House of Organa|House Organa]], Havoc interrogated a prisoner captured by the Organas, [[Markus Andarius Thul]], with the help of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Balic Cormac]] of Organa's defense force. Thul agreed to help Havoc find Gearbox, provided the Lieutenant rescue his [[Altana Thul|wife]] and [[Valyn Thul|daughter]]. First, Havoc took out a gun battery harassing House Organa, then they rescued the women and brought them back to House Organa. While on Alderaan, Havoc was repeatedly interrupted by a noble of House Organa named [[Pallos Thessius Organa|Pallos Organa]]. Havoc deftly avoided Organa's questions, and Thul gave them the location of Gearbox's outpost.<ref name="Prisoner of War">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Prisoner of War|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="Hidden Weapon">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hidden Weapon|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="Friends of my Enemy">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Friends of my Enemy|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="Hard Bargain">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hard Bargain|Alderaan}}</ref>

Gearbox had been designing a new war tank in the time he'd been on Alderaan, and even as Havoc prepared to assault his base, he finalized his plans, completing the tank. When Havoc fought through Gearbox's Imperial guards and reached him, Gearbox manned the tank. He taunted the Lieutenant, saying he was impressed that anyone could infiltrate the base but also degrading them by saying they weren't Havoc material, as Havoc would not have fallen for his trap. The Lieutenant damaged the tank and in the process injured Gearbox. The former Republic commando refused to give up, however, and continued fighting on foot. The Lieutenant was forced to kill him, ending another traitor's life but yet again failing their promise to Kardan. Upon returning to House Organa, the Lieutenant found Pallos interrogating Captain Cormac. He demanded to know why the Lieutenant was allowing three Thul nobles to stay in the Organa household, and wanted to know what deal the Lieutenant had made with Markus. The Lieutenant honored their deal, pardoning Markus and his family, to Pallos' anger.<ref name="The Future of War">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Future of War|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="Gearbox's Garrison">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Gearbox's Garrison|Alderaan}}</ref>

Garza commended them for dealing with Gearbox, though she was saddened that he had been killed, as Havoc had promised Kardan to bring in the traitors alive. She also inquired about how they had caused Pallos trouble. The Lieutenant explained that Pallos had gotten repeatedly in the way of the mission, and Garza said that although she had figured Pallos had been exaggerating, she also wondered if there was truth in his report, and ordered the Lieutenant to be more diplomatic in the future.<ref name="The Future of War" />

====The ''Justice''====
[[File:Tavus01.png|thumb|left|150px|Harron Tavus, leader of the Havoc traitors, and the commander of the ''Justice'']]
With all traitor outposts dealt with, Garza ordered the Lieutenant back to Coruscant. Upon arriving, she said they had a great deal to talk about, and commended the Lieutenant on their valiant efforts on behalf of the Republic. Garza had intercepted a message to the four outposts signaling all survivors to come to a rendezvous point. The Lieutenant was sent to infiltrate the rendezvous point, Tavus' command ship, [[Justice (Harrower-class)|the ''Justice'']].<ref name="Inconspicuous Valor">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Inconspicuous Valor|The Justice}}</ref>

Upon boarding the ship, the Lieutenant was met by an Imperial who asked where they had come from. The Lieutenant lied and gave him the name of one of the previous outposts–Taris, Tatooine, and Alderaan. The Imperial bought the story and then asked if the rumors he was hearing were true regarding a single Republic soldier blasting through their operations. Further embellishing this, the Lieutenant claimed that this soldier was a one-person army. The Imperial let them go on their way. As they went through the ship, the Lieutenant committed various acts of sabotage, eventually ending in the engine room. There, Wraith, one of the last Havoc traitors aside from Tavus, approached the Lieutenant and expressed pleasure at the opportunity to kill the Lieutenant. However, she failed, and was killed. Successfully sabotaging the engines, the Lieutenant and the rest of Havoc headed for the bridge.<ref name="Inconspicuous Valor" /><ref name="Stealth Operative">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Stealth Operative|The Justice}}</ref><ref name="Justice Isn't Blind">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Justice Isn't Blind|The Justice}}</ref>

Upon reaching the bridge, Havoc confronted Tavus. Tavus said the Lieutenant belonged on the ''Justice'' in some twisted way. The Lieutenant responded that Tavus was a traitor, and had nothing to do with Havoc Squad. Tavus shot back that he ''was'' Havoc Squad, along with Fuse, Needles, Gearbox, Wraith, and Kardan. He accused the Lieutenant of murdering all his comrades, but the Lieutenant revealed that Kardan and Fuse were still alive. Though initially relieved, Tavus still held the Lieutenant accountable for the other deaths. Tavus, like Wraith, expressed pleasure at the opportunity to kill the Lieutenant. They fought, and the Lieutenant came out victorious. Wounded, Tavus expressed regret for his actions, acknowledging that he was responsible for his comrades' deaths for leading them to defect. Lowering his blaster, Tavus offered his services to the Republic, saying he could offer valuable intel. The Lieutenant accepted. At that moment, Republic Special Forces boarded the ship. Once the coast was clear, Garza came aboard. She cordially greeted Tavus, expressing relief that he finally decided to surrender. Tavus bemoaned that he lost everything he was fighting for. Garza reminded that the citizens of the Republic were worth fighting for. She then turned to the Lieutenant and she promoted them to Captain. Later, Tavus sent a message to Havoc, expressing his regret at all that had happened and thanking them for sparing him.<ref name="Justice">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Justice|The Justice}}</ref><ref name="Judgement">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Judgement|The Justice}}</ref>

====The Gauntlet====
Havoc Squad didn't get much downtime after the resolution of the Tavus situation.<ref name="Time Off">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Time Off|Carrick Station}}</ref> The Commander was tasked with the difficult extraction of an SIS agent on Tatooine.<ref name="Return to Duty">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Return to Duty|BT-7 Thunderclap}}</ref> The agent had uncovered Imperial plans for a devastating new superweapon, known only as the Gauntlet. With the war still in its cold, smoldering stages, Republic Command could ill afford to allow such a game-changing project to go into effect.<ref name="Operation Blackout">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Operation Blackout|Tatooine}}</ref>

General Garza ordered the Commander and Havoc Squad to neutralize the Gauntlet, in an attempt to mitigate any military advantage such a weapon would give the Empire. However, Havoc Squad was still understaffed for such a dangerous mission, and lacked a demolitions or technical specialist. The Gauntlet Operation hinged on the Commander finding the last key pieces to the reformed commando squad.<ref name="Recruitment Drive">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Recruitment Drive|Balmorra}}</ref>

Garza ordered the Commander to assist and recruit a demolitions expert; a Weequay named Tanno Vik. At that time, Vik was tasked with disruption of the Imperial occupation on Balmorra. And though Havoc Squad was forced to deal with Vik's unorthodox tactics and the Imperial precedence on the planet, they succeeded in recruiting the best demolitions operative in the Republic military.<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Missing in Action|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="Smash and Grab">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Smash and Grab|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="Holding Your Ground">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Holding Your Ground|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="Target Acquisition">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Target Acquisition|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="Reclaim the Village">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Reclaim the Village|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="Den of Thieves">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Den of Thieves|Balmorra}}</ref><ref name="Research and Dismantlement">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Research and Dismantlement|Balmorra}}</ref>

[[File:Gauntlet_Fires.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Gauntlet fires.]]
The mission to Hoth was as uncomplicated as the operation on Balmorra, at least at first. The Commander was tasked with recruiting a Gand named Yuun, a squad commander who was stationed on Hoth. The Commander assisted Yuun and his squad in neutralizing pirate and Imperial forces on the frozen planet, leaving the planet secure for Republic forces and with the final piece of Havoc Squad on board his BT-7 Thunderclap.<ref name="Cold Reception">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Cold Reception|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Finding the Path">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Finding the Path|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Clearing the East Side">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Clearing the East Side|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Clearing the West Side">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Clearing the West Side|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Conspicuous Gallantry">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Conspicuous Gallantry|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Enforcing Your Way">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Enforcing Your Way|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Wipe Out the Raiders">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Third-Party Interest|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Three's a Crowd">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Wipe Out the Raiders|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="There's a Crowd">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Three's a Crowd|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="The Final Piece">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Final Piece|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="The Final Resistance">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|The Final Resistance|Hoth}}</ref><ref name="Catching Up">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Catching Up|Hoth}}</ref>

The Assault on the Gauntlet was arguably the most pivotal military action taken by the Republic on the eve of the renewed Galactic War. Imperial General Rakton would later blame the Commander and Havoc Squad for reigniting the war between the Republic and the Empire.<ref name="Battle of the Gauntlet">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Battle of the Gauntlet|The Gauntlet}}</ref><ref name="Operational Hazards">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Operational Hazards|The Gauntlet}}</ref><ref name="Charge to War">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Charge to War|Carrick Station}}</ref>

===Galactic War===
Once Havoc destroyed the Gauntlet, the Commander was promoted to the rank of Major. But their victory was not without repercussions. The Gauntlet's destruction incensed Imperial General [[Arkos Rakton]], who declared outright hostilities against the Republic. His first move was capturing a group of Republic-aligned heads of state, forcing their respective planets to allow Imperial forces to bypass their borders to assault Republic holdings. Havoc was sent in to liberate the hostages, in an effort to stop Rakton's plans before they were begun.<ref name="Operation Talon">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Operation Talon|BT-7 Thunderclap}}</ref><ref name="Suppression of Hostilities">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Suppression of Hostilities|Outpost 256}}</ref>

====Turning the tide====
After Havoc successfully rescued the hostages, as well as made an enemy out of Rakton, Havoc was deployed to reinforce the Republic offensive, starting with extracting [[Dagger Wing]], a disavowed unit of Republic fighter pilots imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for a botched mission that had resulted in the deaths of thousands of Imperial citizens on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]].<ref name="War Crimes">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|War Crimes|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Change In Plans">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Change In Plans|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Population Control">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Population Control|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Forgotten But Not Gone">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Forgotten But Not Gone|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Overwhelming Force">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Overwhelming Force|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Repair the Surveillance Cameras">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Repair the Surveillance Cameras|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Slicing the Net">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Slicing the Net|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Commando Hunt">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Commando Hunt|Belsavis}}</ref><ref name="Friend or Foe">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Friend or Foe|Belsavis}}</ref>

Then, Havoc was dispatched to space station A-77 to liberate POWs. The Commander was again partnered with another special forces agent, Sergeant Jaxo, in an effort to liberate the prisoners. It turned out that it was a trap set by General Rakton, to eliminate the threat of Havoc Squad and the Major. The Major survived the encounter, but not without making a terrible decision.<ref name="Objective: A-77">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Objective: A-77|A77}}</ref><ref name="No Secret Left Behind">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|No Secret Left Behind|A77}}</ref>

Havoc was then assigned to the planet [[Voss]], where Senator [[Evran]] was withholding thousands of Republic soldiers from the war effort for fear that the Empire would attack Voss again. And as he had [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]]' complete confidence, even Garza couldn't overrule him. Thus, Havoc was forced to eliminate any Imperial invasion vectors, making the overall Republic military presence unnecessary. Havoc proceeded to foil Lord [[Torius]]' plan to utilize the stolen ZR-57 orbital strike bomb to hold [[Voss-Ka]] hostage.<ref name="Power Play">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Power Play|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Local Infantry">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Local Infantry|Voss}}</ref><ref name="A Cultured Approach">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|A Cultured Approach|Voss}}</ref><ref name="A Day in the Life">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|A Day in the Life|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Guns Blazin">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Guns Blazing|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Hostile Negotiations">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hostile Negotiations|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Sneaking Suspicion">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Sneaking Suspicion|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Consequences">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Consequences|Voss}}</ref><ref name="No One Left Behind">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|No One Left Behind|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Into the Shadows">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Into the Shadows|Voss}}</ref><ref name="Imperial Cave In">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Imperial Cave In|Voss}}</ref>

Though the Republic had more than enough strength to turn the tide of the war, Garza was forced to recall Havoc Squad to Coruscant for a Senate inquiry into the squad's activities. Meeting at the spaceport, Garza revealed to the Major that the inquiry was a sham. It was being held by Senator [[Grom Zian]], who was in fact a paid agent for the Empire. It was Rakton's intention to use Zian to suspend Havoc, thus allowing the war to turn in his favor. However, the SIS had gathered evidence proving Zian's ties. Garza ordered the Major to attend the hearing and present the evidence when it was their turn to speak, but avoid anything that could validate Zian's accusations.<ref name="Subtle Maneuvers">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Subtle Maneuvers|Coruscant}}</ref>

Upon arriving at the hearing, the Major stood silently as Zian spoke his allegations, accusing Havoc of having murdered Harron Tavus and covered it up, provoked the Empire by destroying the Gauntlet without Senate approval and apparent lack of contribution to the war effort. Once Zian said his piece, the Major presented the evidence, which the turncoat Senator attempted to deny, but Senator Krasul, repaying Havoc for his rescue, spoke up in defense of the Major. The Senate committee then reviewed the evidence before ordering the Senate Guard to arrest Zian.<ref name="Subtle Maneuvers" />

====Battle of Corellia====
After being dismissed by the committee, Garza contacted Havoc via holo, revealing that she was transferred to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where the Empire and Republic were committing a significant amount of forces to fighting. When the Major landed on the planet, Garza introduced the Major to [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer and former special forces member [[Locke (Corellian)|Locke]], and civilian Captain [[Phaeris]], who had both agreed aid the war effort. Garza told Havoc that their objective was to storm the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]], the center of Republic military operations, which Rakton captured during the initial Imperial invasion. But to get there, they needed a landing zone for Phaeris' group of smugglers to deploy their troops. Garza sent Havoc to capture the Imperial-held landing zone where the smugglers' ships were docked. But after Havoc secured the landing zone, Locke called the squad to beg them to stop the Imperial attack on the residential districts. However, Garza suggested that Havoc instead divert to capture the lightly guarded dropships, but she left the overall decision to the Major. Havoc chose to save the civilians.<ref name="Local Assets">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Local Assets|Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="Smuggling Run">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Smuggling Run|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="Captain Phaeris And Locke">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Captain Phaeris And Locke|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="Extinguish The Imperials">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Extinguish The Imperials|Corellia}}</ref>

Havoc then deployed to [[Labor Valley]] to rally resistance cells to retake a factory.<ref name="Target Rich Environment">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Target Rich Environment|Corellia}}</ref> Afterwards, they met with Garza and Locke at a safehouse in [[Axial Park]]. Garza explained they needed a safe landing zone, for which she had chosen the [[Corellian Museum of Starships]]. However, a famous warship, the ''[[Lucky Lancer]]'', was berthed there. Garza felt it better that it be destroyed, though Locke refused to have a symbol of Corellia heritage destroyed. Instead, Havoc escorted volunteer pilots to move the ship out of the way.<ref name="The Lucky Lancer: Preservation">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Lucky Lancer: Preservation|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="The Lucky Lancer: Destruction">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Lucky Lancer: Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>

Meeting in the government district in a [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] library, Havoc was briefed on the initial infiltration of the Bastion. First, they had to jam its communications, then commandeer an Imperial crawler tank to slip in, taking out the main gate so the [[Safecrackers]] and [[Fifty-third Armored Platoon]] could begin the main assault.<ref name="Forward Momentum">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Forward Momentum|Corellia}}</ref> After the initial assault, the Major then commanded the battle group that had been placed under his command, leading them to victory against the central Imperial defenders. General Rakton faced off against the Major, who dealt with the Imperial general and his bodyguards.<ref name="The Battle of Corellia">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|The Battle of Corellia|Corellia}}</ref><ref name="Operation Clean Sweep">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper Bonus|Operation Clean Sweep|Corellia}}</ref>

Garza reunited with Havoc Squad on Coruscant, where the newly elected Supreme Chancellor, [[Leontyne Saresh]], personally commended the Major and Havoc Squad for bringing down the architect of the Imperial war effort.<ref name="The Battle of Corellia" />

===Eclipse===
Havoc Squad's missions eventually brought the squad to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to hunt down the [[Order of Revan]]. While on the planet, the Major was contacted by Garza, who desired a covert rendezvous in [[Raider's Cove]]. Upon meeting, Garza explained that since Havoc's victory on Corellia, [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] felt Havoc was too valuable and recognizable to continue covert SpecForce work and instead shifted to the front lines. In hopes of creating a replacement, eventually creating cyborg soldiers from [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] technology recovered from [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], forming [[Eclipse Squad]]. At first Eclipse showed no ill side effects, until they pre-emptively massacred two hundred people at Fort Klemark, their implants driving them mad and making them think there were enemies all around them, and went rogue. Now Eclipse had come to Rishi, presumably to track down the Revanites. To bring Eclipse out of hiding, Garza instructed Havoc to disrupt comm relays to force Eclipse into the open.<ref name="Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>

After Havoc eliminated all the rogue Eclipse soldiers, the Major returned to Garza, who admitted that she couldn't cover this incident up like she did Ando Prime and Tavus' defection. The politician would pounce, strip her of her rank and throw her in prison. The Major encouraged her to make amends for her mistakes and come clean to the Senate about SpecForce's full record. Before parting ways with Havoc, Garza shared one last salute with the Major.<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />

===Becoming Chief Military Advisor===
Following the Sith Emperor's revival on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], a joint task force was formed between the military, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and SIS in hopes of locating and destroying the Emperor once and for all. Acknowledging the importance of Havoc Squad and unwilling to lose the elite team on account of Garza's disgrace that would result in a shakeup of SpecForce, Supreme Commander Malcom assigned the Major as the task force's chief military advisor.

===Disappearance===
On the eve of the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|invasion]] of the greater galaxy, the [[Major/Legends|Major]] disappeared under mysterious circumstances. Before their commanding officer could be located, Havoc Squad was called to the front lines to face off against this invading force, with [[M1-4X|4X]] and [[Aric Jorgan|Jorgan]] being stuck in trench warfare for months. Ultimately, the unit fell apart after the Eternal Empire's victory; [[Tanno Vik]] returned to a life of crime, [[Elara Dorne]] was removed from Havoc by Saresh, M1-4X was transferred to the Republic Press Corps, [[Yuun (Gand)|Yuun]] went off to the [[Unknown Regions]] in search of the major, and Aric Jorgan took command of a new Havoc Squad. Despite everyone's best efforts, the Major was declared dead and posthumously awarded the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in honor of their valiant service to the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] over the span of their career.

{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Meteor was in many ways the ideal Republic soldier, being highly patriotic and highly skilled in not only combat, but leadership and tactics. Even Arkos Rakton, the Empire's most feared general who not only was considered one of the top soldiers in the galaxy but possessed extreme contempt for the Republic, viewed the Major with grudging respect, going so far as to call the young commander "the one worthy adversary in the whole Republic." Though suddenly granted the leadership of the most elite squad in the Republic, Meteor quickly adapted and led Havoc to many victories over the Empire.

The soldier was very capable of using a combat [[Knife/Legends|knife]], [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]], [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], [[Sticky grenade/Legends|sticky]] and cryo [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and a [[Blaster/Legends|side arm]]. Surviving intense firefights in battle made them a hero of the Galactic Republic.

==Behind the scenes==
This article represents the character story of the [[Republic trooper]] player class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]] and released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. As a result of being player determined, no canonical description of this individual is currently available; therefore, the article presents the subject's gender as neutral.

The Trooper story was written by [[Charles Boyd]], and the character is voiced by [[Brian Bloom]] for its male version, while the female Trooper is voiced by the prolific voice actress [[Jennifer Hale]], who voiced many ''Star Wars'' characters, including [[Bastila Shan]], [[Satele Shan]], and the female [[Jaden Korr]]. She also voiced the female Commander Shepard in the [[Wikipedia:Mass Effect|Mass Effect]] series. Initially, Meteor can be either a [[Cyborg/Legends|Cyborg]], [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]], or [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], but the players can unlock any species available through gameplay (by completing the third act with a species, with any class) and/or in-game purchase.
